scientific_limitations: Requires reversible environmental state switching and a single common positive speed multiplier.

Illustrative loading and flow triples are stylized and not empirically calibrated.
General prior Markov-environment stationary mean resolvent is known; the inspected materials did not contain the state-count extremum bound.
An older 1986 Markov-modulated queue result and the full 2011 rating-curve article were not inspected in full; historical priority is not independently established.
